messages:
Aisha Patel: Elmwood weekly check-in — quick run through token velocity + throughput. pulling out QoQ/WoW flags we should surface to AMs.
Marco Ruiz: TL;DR: tokens up, latency creeping, a handful of error spikes after large batch runs yesterday. Need to know if onboarding cohort is driving this.
Samir Chen: Agree. Raw numbers from infra logs (yesterday):
```
tokens/day: 1.2M -> 1.6M (WoW +33%)
p95 latency: 210ms -> 245ms (WoW +17%)
error_rate: 0.12% -> 0.18% (WoW +0.06pp)
avg_throughput: 380 reqs/s -> 510 reqs/s (WoW +34%)
spend (hosted): $3.2k -> $3.9k (WoW +22%)
```
Samir Chen: QoQ baseline still healthy but that p95 jump is notable for Elmwood's latency SLA (target <220ms p95).
Ethan Li: @Marco any config changes in their dedicated pool this week? autoscale/batching changes? :thinking_face:
Marco Ruiz: No config pushes from infra. I see onboarding automation enabled for their new team on Mon; that increased concurrent small-chat bursts. OnboardingBot: elmwood-onboard-42 completed step: import_sample_prompts (user: @elmwood_eng).
Aisha Patel: That's helpful — onboarding bursts + low prefix caching hit could hit p95. Samir can you check prefix/KV cache hit rates for Elmwood?
Samir Chen: On it. Quick peek: cache hit dropped from 78% -> 55% during the onboarding window. Likely because imports had many unique prompt prefixes.
Aisha Patel: Risk assessment for renewal: medium — usage rising (good), but SLA breaches risk perception. Recommend enable cached prompt templates + short-term burst cap. Also schedule enablement for Elmwood to walk through caching patterns.
Marco Ruiz: Ops plan: add a temporary policy to route onboarding traffic to a dedicated lower-cost burst pool with higher batching tolerance. ETA to implement: 6 hours. I’ll coordinate with eng-sre.
Ethan Li: I'll set up a 30-min enablement session Thurs 10am PT to show caching and best practices. I'll invite their onboarding lead.
Samir Chen: Follow-ups for infra: investigate whether auto-batching can be more aggressive for small-chat workloads without increasing p99 regressions. Also we'll add a Regen test case for the onboarding prompt set.
Aisha Patel: Customer-facing note: Elmwood CM update — usage +33% WoW, cost +22%, p95 at 245ms (SLA 220ms). Action: schedule enablement + temporary routing to burst pool + follow-up in 48h with metrics. @Ethan please own the enablement. @Marco own routing change. @Samir monitor cache and p95.
OnboardingBot: reminder: enablement session scheduled with Elmwood for 2026-04-09 17:00 UTC (organizer: Ethan Li).
Ethan Li: Got it. I'll send calendar + quick checklist to Elmwood now. :thumbsup:
Aisha Patel: Great — logging this for weekly recap and cross-post to account health triage doc. Thanks team.
